original.target_description: Primary original paper could not be acquired within the acquisition allowance. DOI publisher returned a 403 challenge; OpenAlex had no best OA location; author site had a TLS hostname mismatch; CiteSeer alternative returned 404. Original statistics summarized in the replication article were not substituted for the primary paper.

replication.target_description: Study 4: aggregated homogeneous versus heterogeneous matrix quantity estimates, paired t test. 82 complete cases; programming error caused missing estimates and prevented planned factorial ANOVA.

n.exclusions: 98 people clicked; 82 complete cases. Approximately 18 missing stimulus estimates per participant due to drawing stimuli with replacement; only last estimate retained. Printed t df=80 conflicts with nominal paired sample 82.

reported_success.quote: we failed to replicate the effect of variety on perceived quantity.

notes: Final publication results p. 7, not supplied p. 20. Author-derived d taken from Table 3; body gives dz = -0.039. Printed sample/df inconsistency retained; n=82 is explicitly attached to both conditions in Results.
